notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Cloud of Faeries to your hand from the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Peregrine Drake to your hand from the battlefield.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.
If you control a land that can tap to produce at least {2}, this combo nets infinite mana.
